dry_protein_product.notes: WUR table reports potato feed protein 0.8 EUR/kg and soy concentrates 1.2-2.8 EUR/kg. Grass-derived product must match protein %, digestibility, contaminants and buyer grade; low-price proxy only, not food-grade isolate. | Actual roadside grass protein stream grade is unknown; the report's gel has ~29.7% protein on dry matter and is not equivalent to a dry feed concentrate.
dry_protein_product.basis: Feed protein analogues: potato protein feed approx 800 EUR/t; soy protein concentrate 1200-2800 EUR/t; use only for feed-grade dry protein with verified purity
dry_protein_product.applicability: Analogue benchmark not roadside-grass product quote
dry_protein_product.conversion_method: EUR/t dry product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

press_cake.notes: Dutch forage supplier reports 40-90 EUR/t for silage grass, with quality and transport affecting price. Use only if press cake is feed-safe and sufficiently nutritious; otherwise price may be zero or disposal-cost negative. | Different product: ensiled forage is not dewatered roadside-grass press cake. Confirm dry matter |  digestibility |  contaminants and buyer specification; project reports roadside material contaminants are a concern.
press_cake.applicability: Analogue benchmark not direct press-cake quote
press_cake.conversion_method: EUR/t wet material to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. If ammonium sulfate product, use its benchmark only after product composition is confirmed. | Do not assign standalone price to loaded resin or eluate; assume zero revenue in base TEA until a named |  saleable product and buyer are established.
ion_exchange_product.basis: No single commodity price; conditional ammonium sulfate equivalent 180-390 EUR/t only if regeneration produces fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate meeting spec
ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

financial_assumptions.notes: Industrial benchmark prices activated as screening assumptions; explicit prices take precedence.

financial_kpis.profit_definition: Annual product revenue minus annual operating expenditure before depreciation, tax and financing; replacement CAPEX is in cash flows only.
financial_kpis.gas_volume_basis_warning: Process m3 is not Nm3. Standard temperature, pressure and dry/wet basis are required for normalization.

dry_protein_product.notes: WUR table reports potato feed protein 0.8 EUR/kg and soy concentrates 1.2-2.8 EUR/kg. Grass-derived product must match protein %, digestibility, contaminants and buyer grade; low-price proxy only, not food-grade isolate. | Actual roadside grass protein stream grade is unknown; the report's gel has ~29.7% protein on dry matter and is not equivalent to a dry feed concentrate.
dry_protein_product.basis: Feed protein analogues: potato protein feed approx 800 EUR/t; soy protein concentrate 1200-2800 EUR/t; use only for feed-grade dry protein with verified purity
dry_protein_product.applicability: Analogue benchmark not roadside-grass product quote
dry_protein_product.conversion_method: EUR/t dry product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

press_cake.notes: Dutch forage supplier reports 40-90 EUR/t for silage grass, with quality and transport affecting price. Use only if press cake is feed-safe and sufficiently nutritious; otherwise price may be zero or disposal-cost negative. | Different product: ensiled forage is not dewatered roadside-grass press cake. Confirm dry matter |  digestibility |  contaminants and buyer specification; project reports roadside material contaminants are a concern.
press_cake.applicability: Analogue benchmark not direct press-cake quote
press_cake.conversion_method: EUR/t wet material to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. If ammonium sulfate product, use its benchmark only after product composition is confirmed. | Do not assign standalone price to loaded resin or eluate; assume zero revenue in base TEA until a named |  saleable product and buyer are established.
ion_exchange_product.basis: No single commodity price; conditional ammonium sulfate equivalent 180-390 EUR/t only if regeneration produces fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate meeting spec
ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

financial_assumptions.notes: Industrial benchmark prices activated as screening assumptions; explicit prices take precedence.

financial_kpis.profit_definition: Annual product revenue minus annual operating expenditure before depreciation, tax and financing; replacement CAPEX is in cash flows only.
financial_kpis.gas_volume_basis_warning: Process m3 is not Nm3. Standard temperature, pressure and dry/wet basis are required for normalization.

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. If ammonium sulfate product, use its benchmark only after product composition is confirmed. | Do not assign standalone price to loaded resin or eluate; assume zero revenue in base TEA until a named |  saleable product and buyer are established.
ion_exchange_product.basis: No single commodity price; conditional ammonium sulfate equivalent 180-390 EUR/t only if regeneration produces fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate meeting spec
ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

financial_assumptions.notes: Industrial benchmark prices activated as screening assumptions; explicit prices take precedence.

financial_kpis.profit_definition: Annual product revenue minus annual operating expenditure before depreciation, tax and financing; replacement CAPEX is in cash flows only.

dry_protein_product.notes: WUR table reports potato feed protein 0.8 EUR/kg and soy concentrates 1.2-2.8 EUR/kg. Grass-derived product must match protein %, digestibility, contaminants and buyer grade; low-price proxy only, not food-grade isolate. | Actual roadside grass protein stream grade is unknown; the report's gel has ~29.7% protein on dry matter and is not equivalent to a dry feed concentrate.
dry_protein_product.basis: Feed protein analogues: potato protein feed approx 800 EUR/t; soy protein concentrate 1200-2800 EUR/t; use only for feed-grade dry protein with verified purity
dry_protein_product.applicability: Analogue benchmark not roadside-grass product quote
dry_protein_product.conversion_method: EUR/t dry product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

press_cake.notes: Dutch forage supplier reports 40-90 EUR/t for silage grass, with quality and transport affecting price. Use only if press cake is feed-safe and sufficiently nutritious; otherwise price may be zero or disposal-cost negative. | Different product: ensiled forage is not dewatered roadside-grass press cake. Confirm dry matter |  digestibility |  contaminants and buyer specification; project reports roadside material contaminants are a concern.
press_cake.applicability: Analogue benchmark not direct press-cake quote
press_cake.conversion_method: EUR/t wet material to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. If ammonium sulfate product, use its benchmark only after product composition is confirmed. | Do not assign standalone price to loaded resin or eluate; assume zero revenue in base TEA until a named |  saleable product and buyer are established.
ion_exchange_product.basis: No single commodity price; conditional ammonium sulfate equivalent 180-390 EUR/t only if regeneration produces fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate meeting spec
ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

financial_assumptions.notes: Industrial benchmark prices activated as screening assumptions; explicit prices take precedence.

financial_kpis.profit_definition: Annual product revenue minus annual operating expenditure before depreciation, tax and financing; replacement CAPEX is in cash flows only.
financial_kpis.gas_volume_basis_warning: Process m3 is not Nm3. Standard temperature, pressure and dry/wet basis are required for normalization.

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote

dry_protein_product.notes: WUR table reports potato feed protein 0.8 EUR/kg and soy concentrates 1.2-2.8 EUR/kg. dry_protein_product.applicability: Analogue benchmark not roadside-grass product quote
dry_protein_product.conversion_method: EUR/t dry product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

press_cake.notes: Dutch forage supplier reports 40-90 EUR/t for silage grass, with quality and transport affecting price. press_cake.applicability: Analogue benchmark not direct press-cake quote
press_cake.conversion_method: EUR/t wet material to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

dry_protein_product.basis: Feed protein analogues: potato protein feed approx 800 EUR/t; soy protein concentrate 1200-2800 EUR/t; use only for feed-grade dry protein with verified purity
dry_protein_product.applicability: Analogue benchmark not roadside-grass product quote
dry_protein_product.conversion_method: EUR/t dry product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

press_cake.notes: Dutch forage supplier reports 40-90 EUR/t for silage grass, with quality and transport affecting price. Use only if press cake is feed-safe and sufficiently nutritious; otherwise price may be zero or disposal-cost negative. | Different product: ensiled forage is not dewatered roadside-grass press cake. Confirm dry matter |  digestibility |  contaminants and buyer specification; project reports roadside material contaminants are a concern.
press_cake.applicability: Analogue benchmark not direct press-cake quote
press_cake.conversion_method: EUR/t wet material to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. If ammonium sulfate product, use its benchmark only after product composition is confirmed. | Do not assign standalone price to loaded resin or eluate; assume zero revenue in base TEA until a named |  saleable product and buyer are established.
ion_exchange_product.basis: No single commodity price; conditional ammonium sulfate equivalent 180-390 EUR/t only if regeneration produces fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate meeting spec
ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

financial_assumptions.notes: Industrial benchmark prices activated as screening assumptions; explicit prices take precedence.

financial_kpis.profit_definition: Annual product revenue minus annual operating expenditure before depreciation, tax and financing; replacement CAPEX is in cash flows only.

dry_protein_product.notes: WUR table reports potato feed protein 0.8 EUR/kg and soy concentrates 1.2-2.8 EUR/kg. Grass-derived product must match protein %, digestibility, contaminants and buyer grade; low-price proxy only, not food-grade isolate. | Actual roadside grass protein stream grade is unknown; the report's gel has ~29.7% protein on dry matter and is not equivalent to a dry feed concentrate.
dry_protein_product.basis: Feed protein analogues: potato protein feed approx 800 EUR/t; soy protein concentrate 1200-2800 EUR/t; use only for feed-grade dry protein with verified purity
dry_protein_product.applicability: Analogue benchmark not roadside-grass product quote
dry_protein_product.conversion_method: EUR/t dry product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

press_cake.notes: Dutch forage supplier reports 40-90 EUR/t for silage grass, with quality and transport affecting price. Use only if press cake is feed-safe and sufficiently nutritious; otherwise price may be zero or disposal-cost negative. | Different product: ensiled forage is not dewatered roadside-grass press cake. Confirm dry matter |  digestibility |  contaminants and buyer specification; project reports roadside material contaminants are a concern.
press_cake.applicability: Analogue benchmark not direct press-cake quote
press_cake.conversion_method: EUR/t wet material to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. If ammonium sulfate product, use its benchmark only after product composition is confirmed. | Do not assign standalone price to loaded resin or eluate; assume zero revenue in base TEA until a named |  saleable product and buyer are established.
ion_exchange_product.basis: No single commodity price; conditional ammonium sulfate equivalent 180-390 EUR/t only if regeneration produces fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate meeting spec
ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

financial_assumptions.notes: Industrial benchmark prices activated as screening assumptions; explicit prices take precedence.

financial_kpis.profit_definition: Annual product revenue minus annual operating expenditure before depreciation, tax and financing; replacement CAPEX is in cash flows only.

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.

potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.

dry_protein_product.notes: WUR table reports potato feed protein 0.8 EUR/kg and soy concentrates 1.2-2.8 EUR/kg. Grass-derived product must match protein %, digestibility, contaminants and buyer grade; low-price proxy only, not food-grade isolate. | Actual roadside grass protein stream grade is unknown; the report's gel has ~29.7% protein on dry matter and is not equivalent to a dry feed concentrate.
dry_protein_product.basis: Feed protein analogues: potato protein feed approx 800 EUR/t; soy protein concentrate 1200-2800 EUR/t; use only for feed-grade dry protein with verified purity
dry_protein_product.applicability: Analogue benchmark not roadside-grass product quote
dry_protein_product.conversion_method: EUR/t dry product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

press_cake.notes: Dutch forage supplier reports 40-90 EUR/t for silage grass, with quality and transport affecting price. Use only if press cake is feed-safe and sufficiently nutritious; otherwise price may be zero or disposal-cost negative. | Different product: ensiled forage is not dewatered roadside-grass press cake. Confirm dry matter |  digestibility |  contaminants and buyer specification; project reports roadside material contaminants are a concern.
press_cake.applicability: Analogue benchmark not direct press-cake quote
press_cake.conversion_method: EUR/t wet material to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. If ammonium sulfate product, use its benchmark only after product composition is confirmed. | Do not assign standalone price to loaded resin or eluate; assume zero revenue in base TEA until a named |  saleable product and buyer are established.
ion_exchange_product.basis: No single commodity price; conditional ammonium sulfate equivalent 180-390 EUR/t only if regeneration produces fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate meeting spec
ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

dry_protein_product.notes: WUR table reports potato feed protein 0.8 EUR/kg and soy concentrates 1.2-2.8 EUR/kg. Grass-derived product must match protein %, digestibility, contaminants and buyer grade; low-price proxy only, not food-grade isolate. | Actual roadside grass protein stream grade is unknown; the report's gel has ~29.7% protein on dry matter and is not equivalent to a dry feed concentrate.
dry_protein_product.basis: Feed protein analogues: potato protein feed approx 800 EUR/t; soy protein concentrate 1200-2800 EUR/t; use only for feed-grade dry protein with verified purity
dry_protein_product.applicability: Analogue benchmark not roadside-grass product quote
dry_protein_product.conversion_method: EUR/t dry product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

press_cake.notes: Dutch forage supplier reports 40-90 EUR/t for silage grass, with quality and transport affecting price. Use only if press cake is feed-safe and sufficiently nutritious; otherwise price may be zero or disposal-cost negative. | Different product: ensiled forage is not dewatered roadside-grass press cake. Confirm dry matter |  digestibility |  contaminants and buyer specification; project reports roadside material contaminants are a concern.
press_cake.applicability: Analogue benchmark not direct press-cake quote
press_cake.conversion_method: EUR/t wet material to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. If ammonium sulfate product, use its benchmark only after product composition is confirmed. | Do not assign standalone price to loaded resin or eluate; assume zero revenue in base TEA until a named |  saleable product and buyer are established.
ion_exchange_product.basis: No single commodity price; conditional ammonium sulfate equivalent 180-390 EUR/t only if regeneration produces fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate meeting spec
ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

financial_assumptions.notes: Industrial benchmark prices activated as screening assumptions; explicit prices take precedence.

financial_kpis.profit_definition: Annual product revenue minus annual operating expenditure before depreciation, tax and financing; replacement CAPEX is in cash flows only.
financial_kpis.gas_volume_basis_warning: Process m3 is not Nm3. Standard temperature, pressure and dry/wet basis are required for normalization.

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price

ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

dry_protein_product.basis: Feed protein analogues: potato protein feed approx 800 EUR/t; soy protein concentrate 1200-2800 EUR/t; use only for feed-grade dry protein with verified purity
dry_protein_product.applicability: Analogue benchmark not roadside-grass product quote
dry_protein_product.conversion_method: EUR/t dry product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

press_cake.notes: Dutch forage supplier reports 40-90 EUR/t for silage grass, with quality and transport affecting price. Use only if press cake is feed-safe and sufficiently nutritious; otherwise price may be zero or disposal-cost negative. | Different product: ensiled forage is not dewatered roadside-grass press cake. Confirm dry matter |  digestibility |  contaminants and buyer specification; project reports roadside material contaminants are a concern.
press_cake.applicability: Analogue benchmark not direct press-cake quote
press_cake.conversion_method: EUR/t wet material to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. If ammonium sulfate product, use its benchmark only after product composition is confirmed. | Do not assign standalone price to loaded resin or eluate; assume zero revenue in base TEA until a named |  saleable product and buyer are established.
ion_exchange_product.basis: No single commodity price; conditional ammonium sulfate equivalent 180-390 EUR/t only if regeneration produces fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate meeting spec
ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

financial_assumptions.notes: Industrial benchmark prices activated as screening assumptions; explicit prices take precedence.

financial_kpis.profit_definition: Annual product revenue minus annual operating expenditure before depreciation, tax and financing; replacement CAPEX is in cash flows only.

dry_protein_product.notes: WUR table reports potato feed protein 0.8 EUR/kg and soy concentrates 1.2-2.8 EUR/kg. Grass-derived product must match protein %, digestibility, contaminants and buyer grade; low-price proxy only, not food-grade isolate. | Actual roadside grass protein stream grade is unknown; the report's gel has ~29.7% protein on dry matter and is not equivalent to a dry feed concentrate.
dry_protein_product.basis: Feed protein analogues: potato protein feed approx 800 EUR/t; soy protein concentrate 1200-2800 EUR/t; use only for feed-grade dry protein with verified purity
dry_protein_product.applicability: Analogue benchmark not roadside-grass product quote
dry_protein_product.conversion_method: EUR/t dry product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

press_cake.notes: Dutch forage supplier reports 40-90 EUR/t for silage grass, with quality and transport affecting price. Use only if press cake is feed-safe and sufficiently nutritious; otherwise price may be zero or disposal-cost negative. | Different product: ensiled forage is not dewatered roadside-grass press cake. Confirm dry matter |  digestibility |  contaminants and buyer specification; project reports roadside material contaminants are a concern.
press_cake.applicability: Analogue benchmark not direct press-cake quote
press_cake.conversion_method: EUR/t wet material to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. If ammonium sulfate product, use its benchmark only after product composition is confirmed. | Do not assign standalone price to loaded resin or eluate; assume zero revenue in base TEA until a named |  saleable product and buyer are established.
ion_exchange_product.basis: No single commodity price; conditional ammonium sulfate equivalent 180-390 EUR/t only if regeneration produces fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate meeting spec
ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

dry_protein_product.notes: WUR table reports potato feed protein 0.8 EUR/kg and soy concentrates 1.2-2.8 EUR/kg. Grass-derived product must match protein %, digestibility, contaminants and buyer grade; low-price proxy only, not food-grade isolate. | Actual roadside grass protein stream grade is unknown; the report's gel has ~29.7% protein on dry matter and is not equivalent to a dry feed concentrate.
dry_protein_product.basis: Feed protein analogues: potato protein feed approx 800 EUR/t; soy protein concentrate 1200-2800 EUR/t; use only for feed-grade dry protein with verified purity
dry_protein_product.applicability: Analogue benchmark not roadside-grass product quote
dry_protein_product.conversion_method: EUR/t dry product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

press_cake.notes: Dutch forage supplier reports 40-90 EUR/t for silage grass, with quality and transport affecting price. Use only if press cake is feed-safe and sufficiently nutritious; otherwise price may be zero or disposal-cost negative. | Different product: ensiled forage is not dewatered roadside-grass press cake. Confirm dry matter |  digestibility |  contaminants and buyer specification; project reports roadside material contaminants are a concern.
press_cake.applicability: Analogue benchmark not direct press-cake quote
press_cake.conversion_method: EUR/t wet material to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ammonium_product.notes: Price dry ammonium-sulfate compound equivalent, never carrier water. Recovered solution is not 98-99% agricultural-grade salt; crystallization/drying, purity, contamination, transport and offtake are unverified. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
ammonium_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

phosphorus_product.source_title: user-provided screening price range; no independently verified quote
phosphorus_product.notes: Only actual struvite compound earns baseline revenue. Wet separator solids, dissolved P and a marketed liquid fertilizer blend are not equivalent to pure solid struvite. Pure struvite contains approximately 5.7% N, 12.6% elemental P and no K. No EUR/L conversion without a defined liquid formulation, concentration, density and buyer price. FX: 0.92 EUR/USD is an explicit assumption, not a market quote.
phosphorus_product.basis: dry pure-compound equivalent; no carrier water sold

potassium_concentrate.notes: 19 Oct 2026 bulletin reports 60% K2O Kali at 445-465 EUR/t Niederrhein and 445-449 EUR/t Cologne region; use 435-465 as indicative comparator. This is conventional K fertilizer, not recovered concentrate. | No standardized industrial potassium concentrate grade/market found in Netherlands; normalize by plant-available K2O content and deduct processing/logistics/quality discounts.
potassium_concentrate.basis: 60% K2O granular potash fertilizer benchmark in nearby German wholesale market
potassium_concentrate.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

recovered_water.source_title: Water reuse project and Dutch business water price reporting
recovered_water.notes: Harnaschpolder reuse project reports comparable costs of 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 for large-scale reuse; VEMW reports large industrial users' integrated drinking water tariffs average 1.56 EUR/m3 for >=100,000 m3/year. Value should be treated as avoided purchase cost only if the recovered stream meets user quality specs. | Recovered process water is not automatically saleable; discharge |  treatment and transport costs may dominate and avoided tariff is site/customer-specific.
recovered_water.basis: Reuse-water cost benchmark 0.80-1.00 EUR/m3 at scale; large-business drinking-water price up to 1.56 EUR/m3 in 2026
recovered_water.applicability: Cost avoidance proxy not product sale price

nutrient_rich_solids.source_title: Forage market proxy plus project plan product concept
nutrient_rich_solids.notes: Grass silage market is 40-90 EUR/t but nutrient-rich solids could instead be a low-value residue; base 40 is a scenario placeholder only where agronomic/feed quality and contaminants pass. If waste classification applies, value can be negative after disposal cost. | Must characterize dry matter |  NPK |  contaminants |  pathogens |  stability and legal product status; no generic price for this heterogeneous stream.
nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Use 0-90 EUR/t as conditional range: zero if unqualified; upper proxy based on grass silage forage value
nutrient_rich_solids.applicability: No reliable direct market price; conditional feed/soil-amendment proxy
nutrient_rich_solids.conversion_method: EUR/t wet product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

ion_exchange_product.source_title: Price analogy to ammonium sulfate; no general ion-exchange market price
ion_exchange_product.notes: Ion-exchange resins can recover different ions and regenerate into different products; value depends on ion, regenerant, concentration and purity. If ammonium sulfate product, use its benchmark only after product composition is confirmed. | Do not assign standalone price to loaded resin or eluate; assume zero revenue in base TEA until a named |  saleable product and buyer are established.
ion_exchange_product.basis: No single commodity price; conditional ammonium sulfate equivalent 180-390 EUR/t only if regeneration produces fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate meeting spec
ion_exchange_product.applicability: Not independently priced; contingent coproduct route
ion_exchange_product.conversion_method: EUR/t product to EUR/kg; divide by 1000 for EUR/t to EUR/kg

biomethane.notes: Dry product gas, not compressed process volume or Nm3; sale/injection quality and certificate eligibility remain unverified.
biomethane.basis: dry gas at 20 C and 101325 Pa

financial_assumptions.notes: Industrial benchmark prices activated as screening assumptions; explicit prices take precedence.

financial_kpis.profit_definition: Annual product revenue minus annual operating expenditure before depreciation, tax and financing; replacement CAPEX is in cash flows only.
financial_kpis.gas_volume_basis_warning: Process m3 is not Nm3. Standard temperature, pressure and dry/wet basis are required for normalization.
